beats.say: An extension can work honestly for years. Then its owner changes, and one update turns it into a spy.
Updates like this reached millions of browsers automatically. Users noticed nothing.

visual.label: devices where long-trusted extensions turned into spyware in 2025

beats.say: Watch out if an extension suddenly wants new permissions, your search engine changed, or ads multiplied.

body.text: The new version asks for more permissions:
Read and change all your data on all websites

beats.say: When that happens, remove the extension, tell technical support, and change the passwords they name.

nodes.text: You open the browser in the morning. A note in the corner says: PDF Ustası was turned off because it wants new permissions.

body.text: The new version asks for more permissions.

choices.label: I accept the permissions, I have used it for a year
choices.feedback: Old trust does not make a new permission safe. This update may have turned the extension into a spy.

choices.label: First I look at which permissions it wants
choices.feedback: Right. New permissions show what the extension now wants to do.

nodes.text: New permissions: read and change data on all websites, read what you copy. Opening a PDF needs none of this.

choices.label: I remove the extension and write to technical support
choices.feedback: Right. Technical support will check for this extension on other computers too.

choices.label: I leave it turned off and look later
choices.feedback: A turned-off extension is still in the browser and comes back with one click. Removing it is safer.

nodes.text: A week later your search engine has changed by itself, and unknown ads appear on websites.

choices.label: I remove the extension and call technical support
choices.feedback: Late, but the right move. Technical support will check what leaked.

choices.label: I get used to the ads
choices.feedback: The extension still sees every page you open. The ads are a sign that it is working.

nodes.text: Thank you. This extension collected data on all websites. Change your work mail and portal passwords, and we will close the open sessions.
nodes.speaker: Ayten, technical support
nodes.spoken: Thank you. <breath> This extension collected data on all websites. Change your work mail and portal passwords, and we will close the open sessions.

choices.label: I change the passwords now
choices.feedback: Excellent. Whatever the extension collected is now out of date.

choices.label: I removed the extension, that is enough
choices.feedback: The extension is gone, but the data it collected is with the scammer. The passwords must be changed.

scenes.title: Work computer
scenes.intro: Strange things are happening on your work computer. Answer each warning the right way.

steps.label: Congratulations! You won a phone
steps.say: The browser opened a new tab by itself.

actions.label: Claim the prize
actions.feedback: A tab that opens by itself with a prize is a trap. The page would have asked for your card details.

actions.label: Close the tab
actions.feedback: Right. Tabs that open by themselves are often the work of a harmful extension, so let us find the cause.

body.text: Your searches now go to axtar-tez.example.info.
Changed by: the Kupon Tapan extension

steps.say: The browser says your search setting was changed.

actions.label: Keep the change
actions.feedback: Your searches now go to a stranger's site, which sees everything you type. Change it back.

actions.label: Change it back
actions.feedback: Right. Now let us look at the extension that did it.

steps.label: Extensions: Kupon Tapan, Ekran Şəkli, Qısa Qeyd
steps.say: The list has an extension you never installed.

actions.label: Remove Kupon Tapan
actions.feedback: Right. An extension you do not recognise should not stay in your browser.

actions.label: Keep them all
actions.feedback: Kupon Tapan changed your search and opens tabs. Keeping it leaves your data open to it.

steps.say: Your Downloads folder shows where the extension came from.

actions.label: Open
actions.feedback: This free converter installed the extension in secret. Open it again and the extension comes back.

actions.label: Delete
actions.feedback: Right. This file came with a free program and installed the extension without asking.

body.text: The Kupon Tapan extension was sending browser data to an unknown server.

actions.label: Tell technical support
actions.feedback: Right. Technical support will check what leaked and help you change passwords.

actions.label: Close
actions.feedback: The extension is gone, but the data it collected has already left. Be sure to report it.

scenes.prompt: Match each permission with what it makes possible.

pairs.left: Read and change data on all websites
pairs.right: Read your mail, change a payment page
See a password or card number you copied

scenes.explain: Every permission is a power. Do not give an extension a power its job does not need.

points: Remove an extension that wants new permissions after an update
A search engine that changed by itself, new ads and tabs are warning signs
Remove it, tell technical support, change your passwords
